comparison.objective: Use a scoop to serve clean ice while avoiding contaminated fish-bin ice.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid removal, source selection, scoop loading and pouring, with contact-history hygiene control.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit for a clean-source cube delivered by the scoop after opening the lid, with no contamination or fish-source delivery, sustained 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests source/hygiene selection and scoop use, not simultaneous size-selective passage and retention in a lifted screen.
